description: This file defines the base class DocumentObject within the PdfSharp.Charting namespace. It provides foundational functionality such as cloning and parent-child relationships for chart-related classes.

classes.name: DocumentObject
classes.description: The base class for all chart classes, providing cloning and parent reference management.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the DocumentObject, with the new object's parent set to null.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs the deep copy of the object; can be overridden by subclasses for custom copying logic.
